chain.title: A Core From Something Rare
chain.desc: Eight amethyst shards around any one of a Heart of the Sea, a Nether Star or an End Crystal - the three members of the celestial_core_bases tag.

chain.title: Held in the Furnace
chain.desc: Smelting or blasting the core; the heated form is what the spell book and the ingot line actually consume.

chain.title: Netherite, Elevated
chain.desc: Smithing a Netherite Ingot under a vanilla Netherite Upgrade Template with either a Ghast Tear or a Celestial Core as the addition.

chain.title: Supernal, Refined
chain.desc: Smelting the supernal ingot again; the deeper of the two metals and the one the two hardest weapons demand.

chain.title: The Forge Under the Stars
chain.desc: A crafting table, smithing table and blast furnace bound with obsidian, an iron block and a celestial netherite ingot; every weapon in the mod is forged here and nowhere else.

chain.title: Fallen Where the Moon Struck
chain.desc: Mined from the lunar_crater worldgen feature and also injected into underground dungeon chests.

chain.title: Moonstone, Rendered
chain.desc: Smelted or blasted from lunar stone; it is the core material of the Crescentia.

chain.title: Helm of Lunar Stone
chain.desc: Lunar stone over gold blocks; the mod ships two four-piece armour sets and this is the lighter one.

chain.title: Forged on Moonlight
chain.desc: Lunar scrap in both core slots with a supernal ingot, iron and a 500-tick forge cycle.

chain.title: Fallen Where the Sun Struck
chain.desc: Mined from the solar_crater feature and injected into vanilla Nether structure chests, the sun-side counterpart to lunar stone.

chain.title: Helm of Solar Crystal
chain.desc: The heavier of the two sets, built the same way over gold blocks.

chain.title: Forged on Sunlight
chain.desc: Solar crystal in both core slots with a supernal ingot and a blaze rod beneath.

chain.title: Split From the Spikes
chain.desc: Breaking a wintereis block from the wintereis_spikes feature yields these shards.

chain.title: Forged on Ice
chain.desc: A wintereis shard core over a diamond hoe and packed ice; the shortest forge cycle in the mod at 400 ticks.

chain.title: Wind Made Solid
chain.desc: A block placed by the zephyr_deposit worldgen feature; it is both the block and the item the forge consumes.

chain.title: Forged on Wind
chain.desc: Two zephyr deposits and a supernal ingot over iron, at 700 ticks.

chain.title: An Eye That Should Not Blink
chain.desc: An Ender Eye rubbed with blaze powder; the mod's one shapeless craft and the core of the Poltergeist.

chain.title: Forged on Dread
chain.desc: Two eyebominations, a supernal ingot and an iron axe, at 700 ticks.

chain.title: Forged on Bloom
chain.desc: Any flower as the core with a lily pad and a verdant froglight; the only weapon whose core slot takes a tag rather than a specific item.

chain.title: Torn From a Traverser
chain.desc: The Traverser is the mod's one killable mob - it has a spawn egg and a loot table - and this is what it drops.

chain.title: Forged on Blood
chain.desc: Two crimson pieces with a celestial netherite ingot and netherite beneath, at 800 ticks; the deepest completable weapon in the mod.

chain.title: Bound With Iron's Spellbooks
chain.desc: A heated core, a celestial netherite ingot and paper pressed onto an irons_spellbooks:ruined_book - the mod's one cross-mod recipe, and it needs Iron's Spells n Spellbooks installed.

notes: Forge, 1.20.1, confirmed from META-INF/mods.toml (modId "celestisynth", forge dependency [47,), mandatory geckolib and playeranimator; no fabric.mod.json). The -all classifier is a shaded fat jar, not a multi-loader jar. ID SET. 42 model/item stems intersected with item.celestisynth.<name> gives 31 items; 6 blocks each carry a blockstate and a block.celestisynth.<name> key. Verified set = 37. One lang block key has no blockstate (celestial_crafting_table, the pre-1.3 forge block, kept only so the update-fix recipe can convert it) and it is not quested. NBT-VARIANT CHECK: not applicable - each of the eight weapons is its own registered item id with its own model, lang key and starlit_factory recipe file. OBTAINABILITY - THREE DROPS, ONE OF THEM SIGNIFICANT. celestisynth:starstruck_scrap and celestisynth:starstruck_feather are registered in CSItems.class but have no recipe, no loot table and no worldgen; a scan of every class in the jar finds them referenced only by CSItems, CSCommonSetupEvents and CSRecipeProvider, never by a drop or grant. Because data/celestisynth/recipes/rainfall_serenity.json takes starstruck_scrap as its core material AND its bottom supporting material, celestisynth:rainfall_serenity is uncompletable and was dropped from the chain and from the weapon wheel - the wheel therefore holds seven of the mod's eight weapons, not all eight. Also dropped: celestial_debugger (a developer tool), traverser_spawn_egg (creative only), and star_monolith and star_monolith_blood, which are the Nether monolith structure entity's blocks and have no obtainable form. ENTITY CHECK. Three entities carry lang names (traverser, star_monolith, rainfall_turret) and four have loot tables (traverser, star_monolith, tempest, veilguard). Only traverser is both named and drops something - crimson_piece - so it is the only mob referenced as a kill source. star_monolith's table is empty; tempest and veilguard have empty tables and no lang keys at all; and rainfall_turret is the summon produced by Rainfall Serenity, i.e. exactly the kind of summon body the entity rule forbids using. ORDERING. Read from data/celestisynth/recipes/**: the celestial_core -> heated -> supernal -> celestial ingot spine is forced by smelting and smithing, starlit_factory needs the celestial ingot so it must follow, and each weapon then hangs off its own core material. Weapon order within the eight is set by the forging_time field and by which ingot the recipe demands - the six supernal-ingot weapons at 400-700 ticks precede Keres, which is the only completable weapon requiring the deeper celestial netherite ingot and the longest cycle at 800. Material sources verified from data/celestisynth/worldgen (lunar_crater, solar_crater, wintereis_spikes, zephyr_deposit configured and placed features, all four enabled by matching forge biome modifiers) and from the two chest injections (underground_dungeons -> lunar_stone, vanilla_nether_structures -> solar_crystal). ARMOUR RULE APPLIED: only the two helmets are quested; the remaining six set pieces are in one wheel and no lone chestplate, leggings or boots quest was emitted. CROSS-MOD NOTE for pack assembly: celestial_spell_book hard-requires irons_spellbooks:ruined_book, and irons_spellbooks is an optional dependency in mods.toml - if that mod is absent, drop the final chain step. Three wheels of 6, 7 and 7.
